instruction: Cinematic wide shot of an indoor sports gym with a wooden floor. On the left, the man with the afro and goatee (R1), wearing a white t-shirt and grey sweatpants, stands leaning forward with his hands on his knees. On the right, the young girl in the pink tracksuit (R5) performs a split on the floor, her right arm raised straight up as she looks up at him. Natural light from side windows illuminates the gym, casting soft shadows on the polished floor.
